name: P4 focused quadratic exactness and geometry sanity check v1
classification: Verification, not a speedup experiment; frozen before sampling
minibatching: iid uniform with replacement; purpose-specific independent input stream; deliberate standalone quadratic verification, not a reproduction of previous without-replacement production runs
step_rule: h=0.1/L_P, L_P=lambda_max(P^0.5 Q P^0.5); theta'=theta-h P g+sqrt(2h) L xi, LL^T=P
target: Existing make_gaussian_target tridiagonal covariance finite-sum constructor; use actual assembled Q=X^T X+lambda I and b=X^T y for exact posterior mean Q^-1 b and covariance Q^-1. Heterogeneous per-observation quadratic Hessians; no logistic likelihood.
initialization: All independent replicas at exact Gaussian mode; paired methods share the same pre-generated indices and Gaussian innovations. No burn-in or pooled time samples in endpoint scores.
gradient_check: 32 posterior locations, 128 independent minibatches each, plus anchor and three radial stress locations; compare repository CV1/CV2/SGLD estimators to independent full gradient. Report raw mean squared error, preconditioned mean squared error, maximum relative gradient error, and independent NumPy/JAX agreement. CV2 scaled relative tolerance 1e-10.
trajectory_check: CV2 must explicitly evaluate its minibatch Taylor remainder, not alias to ULA; ULA may use cached exact quadratic Q and b. Paired maximum whitened-coordinate trajectory discrepancy tolerance 1e-8. Check every transition, preserve per-checkpoint ensembles.
distribution_check: Exact finite-K ULA covariance from Gaussian transition eigenvalues; raw and posterior-whitened population W2, covariance error, and stationary discretization bias. Empirical equal-weight full W2 by exact Hungarian assignment for 512 endpoints versus 512 independent exact draws; independent exact-vs-exact floor retained, never subtracted. Empirical covariance error in whitened coordinates divided by sqrt(d). No Gaussian fit presented as empirical OT.
covariance_sanity_gate: For ULA endpoints, Frobenius covariance discrepancy relative to its exact finite-step law divided by sqrt(d) <= 0.5 at every nonzero checkpoint; conservative gross implementation check, not a hypothesis test or confidence interval.
failure: Any nonfinite path or whitened radius above 100 sqrt(d) marks the complete method/metric/seed run failed; no survivor-only scores. If a numerical correctness gate fails, stop and diagnose rather than tuning parameters.
runtime: Verification timing only. Separately record exact-mode solve, metric inverse/factorization, estimator cache setup, JAX compilation, shared fixed-input RNG construction, synchronized kernel time, and scoring. Setup-inclusive warm/cold timing attributes common preparation and input construction once per method ensemble. ULA uses a precomputed quadratic full-gradient oracle, not an N-row full-batch traversal per step. No CV2 speedup ranking or general efficiency inference.
boundaries: Two quadratic cells at fixed d and one design seed; no dimension trend, optimized frontier, ESS claim, or nonquadratic approximation validation. h differs by metric to equalize local stability coefficient, while resulting geometry/mixing still differs. Mode-start transients only, not worst-case mixing guarantees.
tuning: None. Fixed budget, all seeds/cells retained. CPU only; do not pool seconds with P1/P2 GPU.
outputs: Local results/p4_gaussian_sanity_v1 and exports/p4_gaussian_sanity_v1, final report, JSON/CSV metrics, endpoint archives and verification plots
